card.name: Word just before "per" or "each"
card.fires_on: The last word of a quantity or count phrase, right where "per" (as in per line, per family, per nostril) is likely to come next. It fires on units, nouns and number endings such as "user name", "US$12,000" and "pledgets".

modes.label: Noun before per
modes.description: A counted noun is followed by "per" and the unit it is counted against.
modes.example: The at.allow and at.deny files consist of one user<< name>> per line.

modes.label: Number or unit before per
modes.description: A figure or measure ending, such as 000 or mL, sits where "per" would follow.
modes.example: At an average start-up resettlement cost of at least US$12,00<<0>> per family

modes.label: Rate in label text
modes.description: An ingredient amount or limit in a label is about to be stated per dose, injection or site.
modes.example: PHENYLKETONURICS: FLAVORED COLESTID CONTAINS 18.2 MG PHENYLALAN<<INE>> PER 7.5-GRAM DO

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word is "per", as in a rate or ratio.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a rate phrase such as "per line" or "per dose" is about to come next.
